structural_finding.primary: 12 composer advisories remaining post-Wave-5H — most are dev-only OR platform-precondition-not-met (Windows). REAL prod-runtime blockers are 2-3 packages.
structural_finding.secondary: 49 npm advisories — vast majority (40+) are build-time/dev-only (laravel-mix transitives + vitest + happy-dom). Real prod-shipped browser-runtime CVEs = ~5-6 packages (axios + lodash + swiper + sweetalert2 + firebase-js + happy-dom is dev).
structural_finding.tertiary: Laravel 9 EOL is the structural elephant — file-validation CVE has no 9.x fix, only available in 10.48.29+ / 11.44.1+ / 12.1.1+. This is a forcing function for V1.1 Laravel migration.
